X-Files Call Sheets

Daily production records from the making of The X-Files.

61 call sheets22 episodesSeasons 3–8

Call sheets were distributed for each filming day, giving cast and crew the day's scenes, locations, reporting times, and production instructions. Some of these surviving scans also include maps of the locations used for the episode.
